name: ambient-project-layer
description: Quietly captures meaningful project events from Codex work and syncs them to Plane; macOS arm64 runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Quiet project capture and Plane synchronization
interface.longDescription: Capture meaningful Codex work in a local project view and synchronize it to Plane. The formal plugin package currently supports macOS arm64 only and reports a direct compatibility error on other OS/architectures.
defaultPrompt: Maintain a lightweight project view from meaningful work.
